{{Short description|Optical and eyewear industry award in India}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2022}}
'''''VP Awards''''' or '''''VisionPlus Awards''''' is a recognized award for the [[Corrective lens|optical]] and [[eyewear]] industry.

The jury members for the 2014 awards in India were:
* Mr. B K Gupta, GKB Opticals, Kolkata
* Mr. Surendra Gangar, Gangar Eyenation, Mumbai
* Mr. Sudershan Binani, Himalaya Optical, Kolkata
* Mr. Hemanth Manay, S R Gopal Rao Optical, Bangalore
* Mr. Snehal Turakhia, Turakhia Opticians, Chennai<ref>{{cite web |url=http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=7315 |title=Nomination Round Concludes Successfully At VP Awards Jury Meet – Excitement Continues {{!}} VisionPlus Magazine |website=visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150118163314/http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=7315 |archive-date=2015-01-18}}</ref>

The VP Awards were announced on 9 March 2014, at the Westin Mumbai Garden City in [[Goregaon]].
Singer [[Nakash Aziz]], of Indian Idol fame,  performed at the program.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=8387 |title=Optical Industry Stars In VP Awards And The Launch Of 'Visionaries' {{!}} VisionPlus Magazine |website=visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150118164418/http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=8387 |archive-date=2015-01-18}}</ref>

After its launch in the India market the awards collaborated with the [[Dubai World Trade Centre]]'s Vision-X exhibition to bring out the awards under the title '''''Vision-X VP Awards''''' in the Middle East.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://vxvp-awards.com/web/about.php |title=Welcome to VXVP Awards |website=vxvp-awards.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150118162355/http://vxvp-awards.com/web/about.php |archive-date=2015-01-18}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.vision-x.ae/page.cfm/action=press/libID=1/libEntryID=20/listID=1 | title=IMail Web Client - Login }}</ref>

The nominations Jury saw the coming together of some of the biggest names in the Middle Eastern eyewear retail.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=12560 |title=Vision-X VP Awards Jury Nomination : A Truly Special Event Held on September 11 at Dubai World Trade Centre | VisionPlus Magazine |access-date=2015-01-18 |archive-date=2015-01-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150118164509/http://visionplusmag.fourplusmedia.com/?p=12560 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
Mr Kian Saadat represented Hassan's, Mr Saeed Emam and Mr Khaled Mahmoud represented Magrabi Opticals, Mr Uday Shrikantiya and Mr Avinash Dudeja represented Rivoli EyeZone, Mr Mamdoh Rouhani represented Saudi Optic House and Mr Ali Yateem and Mr Mathews Jacob represented Yateem Opticians.

The awards were given away on the conclusion of the first day of the Vision-X exhibition in Dubai.<ref>[https://www.zawya.com/story/His_Excellency_Abdul_Rahman_Saif_Al_Ghurair_opens_VisionX_2014-ZAWYA20141125095151/ His Excellency Abdul Rahman Saif Al Ghurair opens VisionX]zawya.com 2014 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150328182605/https://www.zawya.com/story/His_Excellency_Abdul_Rahman_Saif_Al_Ghurair_opens_VisionX_2014-ZAWYA20141125095151/ |date=28 March 2015 }}</ref>

VP Awards or VisionPlus Awards is a recognized award for the optical and eyewear industry.
The jury members for the 2014 awards in India were:

Mr. B K Gupta, GKB Opticals, Kolkata
Mr. Surendra Gangar, Gangar Eyenation, Mumbai
Mr. Sudershan Binani, Himalaya Optical, Kolkata
Mr. Hemanth Manay, S R Gopal Rao Optical, Bangalore
Mr. Snehal Turakhia, Turakhia Opticians, Chennai
The VP Awards were announced on 9 March 2014, at the Westin Mumbai Garden City in Goregaon.
Singer Nakash Aziz, of Indian Idol fame,  performed at the program.

After its launch in the India market the awards collaborated with the Dubai World Trade Centre's Vision-X exhibition to bring out the awards under the title Vision-X VP Awards in the Middle East.
The nominations Jury saw the coming together of some of the biggest names in the Middle Eastern eyewear retail.
Mr Kian Saadat represented Hassan's, Mr Saeed Emam and Mr Khaled Mahmoud represented Magrabi Opticals, Mr Uday Shrikantiya and Mr Avinash Dudeja represented Rivoli EyeZone, Mr Mamdoh Rouhani represented Saudi Optic House and Mr Ali Yateem and Mr Mathews Jacob represented Yateem Opticians.
The awards were given away on the conclusion of the first day of the Vision-X exhibition in Dubai.
